families.decision: Alloy Smelter is a stone multiblock whose FurnaceHandler burns live vanilla furnace fuel; TagOutput may resolve via mod-preference for tag results. No simulate-then-commit station/fuel contract.
Arc Furnace is a multiblock with live RecipeMultiplier energy/time modifiers and chance secondary outputs (randomness).
Arc recycling is a generated multiblock Arc Furnace specialization without a complete deterministic Auto Storage transaction contract.
Blast Furnace is a stone multiblock that also requires separate BlastFurnaceFuel burn state; TagOutput slag/result may be preference-resolved tags.
Blueprint crafting requires a typed Engineers Blueprint plus Engineer's Workbench/Auto Workbench multiblock path; MultiblockRecipe multipliers apply for the automatic workbench.
Bottling Machine is a multiblock with live RecipeMultiplier energy/time modifiers.
Garden Cloche outputs use StackWithChance and ApiUtils.RANDOM; getOutputs streams chance results (randomness/unbounded_output).
Coke Oven is a stone multiblock with live tank capacity for creosote fluid output; batching depends on tank/inventory state.
Crusher is a multiblock with live RecipeMultiplier modifiers and chance secondary outputs (randomness).
Fermenter is a multiblock with live RecipeMultiplier energy/time modifiers.
